competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease the Attack Bar by 30% with a 50% chance.
Attacks all enemies to remove all beneficial effects granted on them and to increase the chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 50% chance each.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)

The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Grants Immunity on all allies for 3 turns, and decreases the ally target's chance of receiving a Critical Hit for 3 turns. The selected target will go under the Threat state while enemies attack with a single-target skill 3 times. Gains a turn instantly afterwards.

effets.description: The target will gain immunity against all harmful effects.

The enemy can only attack the target under the Threat state when using the attack skill. The duration of the Threat will be reduced only by skills that attack a single enemy target. The target under the Threat state will be inflicted with 15% less damage when attacked.
Decreases the chance of being attacked with a Critical Hit
